title: ADC, LEDC PWM, and touch

spans.text: Goal: apply “ADC, LEDC PWM, and touch” to a real program or device. The key principle is: ADC pin availability and behavior vary across ESP32 chips. In a project, follow this guidance: Account for noise, calibration, and input range in ADC measurements.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
Serial Monitor prints the ADC reading, and PWM output brightness follows the sensor value; ADC range and usable pins depend on the chip.
ADC units, channels, and attenuation vary by ESP32; raw readings are not automatically voltage. LEDC generates PWM with timers/channels, while touch support depends on the variant.

Key line: `int reading = analogRead(sensorPin);`
